install.title: Add BPM to your home screen
install.intro: Save BPM to your home screen and it opens full-screen, like a normal app.
install.bannerTitle: Add BPM to your home screen

ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
ios.step3: Tap "Add" — BPM lands on your home screen.
ios.note: On Android, open the browser menu (⋮) and tap "Add to Home screen" instead.

android.step1: Tap the menu (⋮) in your browser's toolbar.
android.step3: Confirm — BPM lands on your home screen.
android.note: On iPhone, tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen" instead.

stats.subheadV2: Where your game is, and what to do about it

gear.kitSubtitle: What you play with. Logging it is what makes the club tally useful.
gear.kitError: Couldn't load your kit — refresh to try again
gear.tensionSubtitle: From your level and how you play.
gear.tensionLowLevel: A lower tension gives you a bigger sweet spot and more power for free while your technique is still settling.
gear.tensionMidLevel: Around here you start trading a little free power for control — this is a sensible middle to try.
gear.tensionHighLevel: At your level the bed is about control and feel, so a tighter string makes placement more repeatable.
gear.tensionAdvisory: A starting point, not a spec — talk to whoever strings your racket.
gear.clubFootnote: Logging your strings is what makes this list useful — for you and for whoever stocks up.

gear.railShoesSoon: Court shoes matched to your footwork and fit.

consent.title: See how you compare?
consent.body: We can show where each of your skills sits against the rest of the club — top, middle or bottom third.
consent.bands: Bands only — never a number, a name or a leaderboard.

privacy.title: Stats & privacy
privacy.comparisonSubtitle: Show where your skills sit against the rest of the club.
privacy.stateOn: On — you'll see your band on every compared skill.
privacy.stateOff: Off — you'll still see the club spread, just not your own place in it.
privacy.kudosBody: Kudos are anonymous. The player you send one to sees the tag, never who sent it.
privacy.ratingsBody: Only ever used to build your own bands and drills.
privacy.levelBody: There is no club leaderboard, and no plan for one.
privacy.kitBody: "Nine players use BG65" — a tally, never who.
privacy.closing: Turning comparison off doesn't hide anything from other players — nothing about your skills was ever shown to them. It only changes what <you>you</you> see. The club spread stays visible either way.
privacy.offline: You're offline — this needs a connection.
